title: 電透析除鹽系統
summary: 以「離子遷移、極化與淡濃水收支」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow ion transport, polarization and dilute/concentrate balances through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 定義除鹽負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Define the desalination load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 定義除鹽負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Define the desalination load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先把流量和鹽濃度轉成相同時間基準的質量流率；導電度只是在離子組成固定時的替代量。
steps.instructionEn: Convert flow and salt concentration into a mass rate on one time basis; conductivity is a surrogate only for a stable ionic composition.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Q=20 m3/h; C=1.5 kg/m3; m=QC；計算 20*1.5 = 30 kg/h。適用限制：穩態且忽略密度改變。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Q=20 m3/h; C=1.5 kg/m3; m=QC; calculation 20*1.5 = 30 kg/h. Applicability: Steady state with negligible density change.
steps.failure: 只比較導電度會掩蓋流量增加造成的鹽負荷上升。
steps.failureEn: Conductivity alone hides a salt-load increase caused by higher flow.
steps.check: 改變流量而固定鹽濃度，核對質量流率斜率。
steps.checkEn: Vary flow at fixed salinity and check the mass-rate slope.

steps.title: 電荷與離子當量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Charge and ionic equivalents: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 電荷與離子當量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Charge and ionic equivalents and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 膜選擇性和電流效率把電荷流轉成有效離子輸送；以當量而非總離子莫耳直接計數。
steps.instructionEn: Membrane selectivity and current efficiency convert charge into useful ionic transport; count charge equivalents rather than unweighted ion moles.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：n_eq=eta I t/F; eta=0.9; I=10 A; t=3600 s; F=96485 C/mol；計算 0.9*10*3600/96485 = 0.335803 mol-equivalent。適用限制：單一膜對等效量，不乘未定義的膜數。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: n_eq=eta I t/F; eta=0.9; I=10 A; t=3600 s; F=96485 C/mol; calculation 0.9*10*3600/96485 = 0.335803 mol-equivalent. Applicability: Equivalent transfer for one cell pair; no undefined cell-count multiplier.
steps.failure: 把二價離子當成一價會低估所需電荷。
steps.failureEn: Treating divalent ions as monovalent underestimates charge demand.
steps.check: 改變電流並量測淡濃水離子收支，以反算效率。
steps.checkEn: Vary current and use dilute/concentrate ionic balances to infer efficiency.
